hyperedges.label: Return lifecycle: intake to filed return

nodes.label: Server-Only Keys (SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY, CRON_SECRET)
nodes.rationale: CRON_SECRET ensures only Vercel can trigger /api/cron/generate-filings; secret key never in browser or chat.

nodes.label: Withholding Returns Follow Calendar Year (calendar_year flag)
nodes.norm_label: withholding returns follow calendar year (calendar_year flag)

nodes.label: Nightly Filing Instance Generation (120 days ahead, 60 back)
nodes.norm_label: nightly filing instance generation (120 days ahead, 60 back)

nodes.label: Weekend/Holiday Roll to Next Working Day
nodes.norm_label: weekend/holiday roll to next working day

nodes.label: Deadline Rules Are Data, Not Code
nodes.norm_label: deadline rules are data, not code
nodes.rationale: A BIR change means adding a row with a new effective date; Owner edits rules in Settings.

nodes.label: Magic Link Email with 6-digit Code
nodes.rationale: Code helps when the email is opened on a phone but sign-in happens on a computer.

nodes.label: Resend Custom SMTP
nodes.rationale: Supabase built-in sender only delivers to org members, is rate limited, and has non-editable templates.

nodes.label: ocr-provider Interface (Gemini paid tier)
nodes.rationale: Paid tier only because free tier may train on data; swappable component.

nodes.label: Invite-Only Sign-In (signups disabled)
nodes.rationale: Only people the Owner invites can sign in; anyone else (email or Google) gets no account.

nodes.label: Roles: Owner, Acting Approver, Reviewer, Staff, Client User
nodes.norm_label: roles: owner, acting approver, reviewer, staff, client user

nodes.label: Tax Computation & Returns
nodes.rationale: Returns computed from ledger so books and returns cannot disagree; nothing retyped.

nodes.label: Fee Schedule & Pricing
nodes.rationale: Low entry, fair scaling (Q54): volume, annual work and complexity charged as add-ons.

nodes.label: Gross Receipts Watch (P2.5M warning before P3M VAT)
nodes.norm_label: gross receipts watch (p2.5m warning before p3m vat)

nodes.label: Assigning an Uploaded Document to a Period
nodes.norm_label: assigning an uploaded document to a period

nodes.label: OCR Intake & Review Queue
nodes.rationale: No document affects a return until staff approves it; corrections logged for OCR correction rate.

nodes.label: Notifications & Automation (Resend, n8n plumbing only)
nodes.rationale: Tax rules, deadlines and accounting logic stay in the app where they are version-controlled and tested.

nodes.label: Postgres Row-Level Security
nodes.rationale: Access enforced in the database, not only in screens (Q13).

nodes.label: Tallo CPA Brand Design System
nodes.rationale: Goal: a site that does not look AI-generated.

nodes.label: Staff Capacity: Load Points = Retainer / P1,000 (rule of thirds)
nodes.norm_label: staff capacity: load points = retainer / p1,000 (rule of thirds)

nodes.label: TalloCPA OS Product Specification
nodes.rationale: Replaces Moxie and Manager.io with one system; nothing built until Owner signs off; sections cite decisions Qn.

nodes.label: graphify Usage Rules
nodes.rationale: Query the knowledge graph (query/path/explain/section) before raw grep or file reads; run graphify update after code changes; large graph.json diffs are expected.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules (breaking-changes notice)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes; agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs before writing code. Block is auto-regenerated by next dev, so commit it to keep the tree clean.

nodes.label: Decisions Log (Q1-Q61)
nodes.rationale: Owner's answer wins where it differs from the recommendation; July 2026 planning artifacts are superseded on conflict.

nodes.label: Q11: n8n Is Plumbing Only
nodes.rationale: Business rules stay in the app; n8n only moves data and sends reminders.

nodes.label: Q20: Editable Deadline Rules with Effective Dates
nodes.norm_label: q20: editable deadline rules with effective dates

nodes.label: Q21/Q25: Sign-off Chain and Payment Check
nodes.norm_label: q21/q25: sign-off chain and payment check
nodes.rationale: Tax dues and retainer must be paid before approval, but Owner may approve unpaid and the amount becomes a client receivable.

nodes.label: Q3: OS Replaces Moxie and Manager.io
nodes.norm_label: q3: os replaces moxie and manager.io

nodes.label: Q60: Brand and Legal Entity as Database Settings
nodes.norm_label: q60: brand and legal entity as database settings
nodes.rationale: Enables a later separate nationwide brand (Q56) without code changes.

nodes.label: Q61: Many-to-Many Client Users and Staff OCR Upload
nodes.norm_label: q61: many-to-many client users and staff ocr upload

nodes.label: Q9: Gemini OCR with Staff Review
nodes.norm_label: q9: gemini ocr with staff review
nodes.rationale: Gemini chosen because it handles handwritten invoices; every extraction goes through staff review.
